summary.text: Richard Briggs is a Republican state senator from Knoxville who represents Tennessee Senate District 7 in part of Knox County and is listed as the incumbent candidate in the 2026 election.
A physician and retired U.S. Army colonel, he chairs the Senate State and Local Government Committee.

paragraphs.text: Richard Briggs was born on December 7, 1952, and is married to Stephanie.
He holds an M.D. from the University of Kentucky, is a physician, and retired from the U.S. Army as a colonel.
Briggs has been a member of the Senate from the 109th through the 114th General Assemblies.
He chairs the Senate State and Local Government Committee and is a member of the Transportation and Safety and Rules committees.
